verdict.rationale: Databricks' Trust Center compliance page explicitly documents SOC 2 Type II reports and a broader certification portfolio, directly addressing platform-engineer compliance-review needs, and this is reinforced by Unity Catalog's built-in access control, lineage, and audit logging documentation which supports such attestations operationally. Missing for 10: explicit mention of HIPAA and PCI attestations/BAA details in the evidence pack, and no independent/third-party audit confirmation beyond the vendor's own trust page.
